method: Exact DOI/title/author/year comparison against permanent MMSC identities and prior exact-locator audits. Raw WEB-MUN records are preserved as audit observations even when later reconciled as duplicates.

finding.title: Stories of Ancient Stones: A Living Tradition of Indigenous People (Mundas) in Jharkhand, India
finding.evidence: SRC-MMSC-000002 already carried DOI 10.30884/seh/2025.02.01 and the identical title, author set and year before WEB-MUN-0089 was registered. The prior exact-locator verification MMSC-VERIFY-TUTI-SEH-2026-09-09-RUN111 explicitly states permanent_identity SRC-MMSC-000002 and duplicate_source_created false. WEB-MUN-0089 is therefore retained only as a later raw publisher-manifestation/audit observation and must not increase unique-lead, unresolved-lead or audited-source counts.
finding.rights_boundary: Publisher readability and study-reported verbal consent do not establish unrestricted redistribution, MLHKP secondary-use consent, community-wide validation, or permission to expose participant-derived cultural material. Existing cultural-access controls remain in force.
